title: The Greatest Story Ever Run — Comrades Marathon Launches 2027 Centenary Edition
claims: The CMA officially launched the 2027 centenary edition in Durban; the finish is the Kings Park sport precinct, the entry cap is 28,000, and 2027 is the 100th edition of the race.

The Comrades Marathon was first run in 1921 and has taken place nearly every year since, except five years during the Second World War (1941–45) and two years during the COVID pandemic (2020 and 2021).

The 2027 race is both the 100th edition overall and the 50th edition of the traditional Down Run, starting in Pietermaritzburg and finishing in Durban; the event runs in alternating directions between the two host cities each year.

The 2025 Down Run holds the Down Run entry record with 24,172 entries; the 2019 Up Run had 24,636 entries; the 2025 Down Run measured 89.98 km, and the longest route in Comrades history was the 92 km course of 1971.

With the finish moving to the Kings Park precinct, the 2027 route is expected to measure approximately 91 km; the official distance will be confirmed after formal measurement following ongoing roadworks expected to shorten several sections.

Entry fees for 2027 remain unchanged; fees have not increased since 2022. The 2027 entry process opens Tuesday 25 August 2026 in three phases, with the first window reserved for Green Number Club athletes.

Quick facts published by the CMA: race date Sunday 13 June 2027; Down Run Pietermaritzburg to Durban; start Pietermaritzburg City Hall at 05:00; finish Kings Park Rugby Precinct, Durban; distance approximately 91 km pending measurement; 12-hour time limit; on-route intermediate cut-offs to be announced in due course; campaign slogan The Greatest Story Ever Run.
